name: qa-graphql
description: GraphQL server testing for Apollo Server, GraphQL Yoga and Hasura: subscriptions, N+1 detection and fixes, and depth and cost limit hardening. Mercurius is covered in the Yoga references, and introspection and persisted-query hardening in the limits skill. Distinct from qa-contract-testing/graphql-schema-regression, which detects schema drift; this plugin tests the server runtime.
